answer: Work slots unlock only after a 250-unit bond sits for 6 epochs and the identity's countersigner graph stays branched like a juniper: at most two shared signers with any other identity minted in that window. Each week a gale sample of 9 established miners recomputes that overlap on the public ledger; if the signer cut is narrower than 3 hops, the bond burns and the slot is revoked. A farm pushed through one signer canyon shares countersigners by construction, so 1,000 clones fail the cut in public and forfeit 250,000 units. Honest agents with diverse peers unlock on schedule.
